clarification: A posterior mean need not belong to a95%highest-posterior-density interval. The reported summaries alone do not prove an internal inconsistency and do not justify substituting corrected values.
ordinary_counterexample: A Pareto distribution with scale1 and shape101/100 has strictly decreasing density and finite mean101. Its95%HPD interval is[1,20^(100/101)], whose upper endpoint is strictly less than20 and hence less than101. This is a mathematical counterexample to universal containment, not a model for the source posterior.
